handback.summary: Hotfix pull requests get the label, design asks return to planning with a comment, and hotfix cards are one line.

criteria.864.1: `agent.yml` adds `--label` with the hotfix label's name to `gh pr create` when the pack is a hotfix.
criteria.864.2: `agent_roles.py` starts the planner when a hotfix worker's passed hand-back raises a blocker for the planner.
criteria.864.3: `hotfix.back_to_planning` now also runs for that worker, saying the ask needs a design choice, with its blockers.
criteria.864.4: `card.render` draws an unplanned hotfix as one line from `card.hotfix_line`, starting with its status.
criteria.864.5: `card.hotfix_line` shows the owner's ask from below the marker, its lines joined into one.
criteria.864.6: `card.hotfix_line` links the open pull request; with none it links nothing.
criteria.864.7: `card.hotfix_line` says code review approved or blocked from the newest code review since the build.
criteria.864.8: `card.gate_result` reads that review's Next line: merge gate failed, passed, or nothing before it ran.
criteria.864.9: Already true: `agent.yml` opens every worker's pull request with `Closes #N`; untouched.
criteria.864.10: The new `worker.md` hotfix line names nothing from this repo.
